DentalSegmentator model attribution notice

Model checkpoints
-----------------
Title: DentalSegmentator nnU-Net pretrained model for CBCT image segmentation
Creator: Gauthier Dot
Creator ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2014-2623
DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10829675
Source: https://zenodo.org/records/10829675
File: Dataset112_DentalSegmentator_v100.zip
Published checksum: MD5 b71cd5230168d28a4f71b078265b76be
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The model checkpoints are downloaded separately from Zenodo on first use and
are not part of the repository or the macOS application bundle. The application
verifies the published checksum and records the DOI, source, checksum, and
license in local model metadata.

Changes made by this project
----------------------------
The downloaded checkpoint parameters are not modified. During installation,
the published nnU-Net archive is verified and installed into the application's
private model directory. This project provides independent Apple Silicon MPS
inference integration, input/output conversion, progress reporting, and local
macOS application glue around the checkpoint.

Related code
------------
The separately maintained SlicerDentalSegmentator project is available at:
https://github.com/gaudot/SlicerDentalSegmentator

Its code is licensed under the Apache License 2.0. This application is an
independent, unofficial integration and does not claim endorsement by the
model creator or upstream projects.
